ivory-page.$description: Ivory Page — Primary canvas — page background, card surfaces, light section bands

sandstone.$description: Sandstone — Secondary surface — alternating bands, section dividers, subtle card fills

pebble-border.$description: Pebble Border — Hairline borders, button outlines, nav dividers, card edges

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Muted decorative borders and tonal accents where a softer line is needed

stone-mid.$description: Stone Mid — Mid-neutral text, icon strokes, secondary borders

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, link borders, icon color — the workhorse neutral for readable content

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Heading text, emphasized body copy, dark surface text

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary action fill, strongest text, dominant border color — the visual anchor

jet-black.$description: Jet Black — SVG fills, icon strokes, maximum contrast accents

smoke.$description: Smoke — Decorative SVG fills and strokes — vector artwork on dark sections

honey-yellow.$description: Honey Yellow — Primary brand accent — announcement bar, highlight badges, decorative blocks, the signature warm punctuation against cream

burnt-umber.$description: Burnt Umber — Dark warm accent — button fills in warm contexts, icon borders, tertiary buttons needing chromatic weight

powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — Cool accent — secondary CTA fills, info badges, test card backgrounds, the soft counterpoint to honey yellow

ash.$description: Ash — Subtle border accent, near-gray for dividers that need to recede

instrument-sans.$description: Primary typeface for all editorial and UI text — display headlines compress to 0.75 with -3.17em tracking, body sits at 1.5–1.71 with relaxed tracking

geist-mono.$description: Monospaced label face for nav items, buttons, badges, and tags — set uppercase with wide positive tracking to read as typeset stamps

font-awesome-7-sharp.$description: Icon glyphs rendered at heavy weight — sharp geometric forms that match the editorial type system
